description: Registro atomico de reservas por hojas del Tablero Vivo. Aislado de main; no ejecuta agentes ni despliega codigo.

claim_policy.scope: task IDs as listed in board issue; parent area and child task are mutually exclusive
read_first: recent PRs and recent PIN comments
claim_policy.acquisition: Commit updated JSON against currently read branch HEAD, update ref with expected_sha; on mismatch retry read, do not work until claim succeeds
claim_policy.stale_behavior: not auto-free; CEO-authorized checked transfer only
claim_policy.identity: Agent self-declared; GitHub authenticated account and commit/comment UTC provide audit trail
claim_policy.release: Publish result PIN with tested SHA and outcome, then remove only own claim using compare-and-swap update
claim_policy.enforcement_limit: Cooperative agent convention; no forced GitHub merge gate

resource_policy.avoid: redundant CI/reviews, repetitive broad scans, re-reading full history or spending tokens on avoidable reports
resource_policy.special_rule: Use existing required CI only when actual code change warrants it; no reruns for same SHA without explanation
resource_policy.safeguards: Independent review for security changes; no secrets, remote database, merge, production deploy or paid API without separate authorization.
